title: Electrical
note: Power and installation for control panels and machines, to UK practice: BS 7671 (the IET Wiring Regulations), BS EN 60204-1 and the Electricity at Work Regulations 1989. Check the current edition before relying on a figure.

lessons.title: Safe isolation and lock-off: proving dead, GS38, the Electricity at Work Regulations
AC power: kW, kVA and power factor
Three-phase: star and delta, line and phase, 400/230 V
Transformers and 24 V DC supplies: sizing and fusing
Harmonics and power quality (VFDs on the supply)
Protective devices: fuses, MCB curves, RCDs, discrimination
Cables: current rating and volt drop (the BS 7671 method)
Earthing and bonding: TN-S, TN-C-S, TT, fault loop impedance
Inspection and testing: insulation resistance, continuity, Zs
Motor circuits: DOL, star-delta, soft starters, contactors and overloads
Control panels: layout, BS EN 60204-1, wire colours, terminals
Hazardous areas: ATEX, DSEAR and zones
